spans.s:
m. (-ङ्खः)
1 Disappointing, deceiving.
2 A horse's hoof.
3 One of a horse's paces.
4

Sliding, slipping.
E.
रिखि to go, aff. अच्.

n. (-णं)
Slipping, sliding, stumbling, tumbling; or figuratively, deviating from rectitude or virtue.
E.
रिखि to go, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
1 Creeping, (as a child on all fours.)
2 Tumbling, slipping, sliding.
3 Deviating from rectitude, sliding from virtue.
E.
रिगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
